Figure 2-6. West Bad Creek just upstream from its junction with Howard Creek and adjacent Highway 171 berm on the right. An estimated 2 to 4 cfs is flowing over a sand bottom. December 11, 1973 photo by Staff.
Figure 2-7. Howard Creek just upstream from the junction of Bad Creek. The stream substrate was composed of some cobble with a majority of sand; water was slightly turbid. December 12, 1973 photo by Staff.
